questions.prompt: The dog was lying behind the door, watching the guests.
questions.answer: Canis pōne iānuam iacēbat, hospitēs spectāns.

questions.prompt: Beyond the river and outside the city the exiles were wandering.
questions.answer: Ultrā flūmen et extrā urbem exsulēs errābant.

questions.prompt: The philosopher spoke about virtue against the opinion of the crowd.
questions.answer: Philosophus dē virtūte contrā opīniōnem vulgī dīxit.

questions.prompt: In time of war the highest power lies in the hands of the consul.
questions.answer: Bellī tempore summa potestās penes cōnsulem est.

questions.prompt: The wise judge decided everything according to the law.
questions.answer: Iūdex sapiēns omnia secundum lēgem dēcrēvit.

questions.prompt: The eagle flew high above the clouds and over the mountains.
questions.answer: Aquila altē suprā nūbēs et super montēs volāvit.

questions.prompt: On this side of the river the farmers cultivate fertile fields.
questions.answer: Cis flūmen agricolae agrōs fertilēs colunt.

questions.prompt: Below the citadel, this side of the river, the enemy pitched camp.
questions.answer: Īnfrā arcem, citrā flūmen, hostēs castra posuērunt.

questions.prompt: About midnight the fleet was carried across the stormy sea.
questions.answer: Circiter mediam noctem classis trāns mare turbidum vēcta est.

questions.prompt: Around the walls, above the gate, the enemy's spoils were hanging.
questions.answer: Circā moenia, suprā portam, spolia hostium pendēbant.

questions.prompt: Against the excellent general no one dared to advance beyond the gates.
questions.answer: Adversus excellentem ducem nēmō ultrā portās prōgredī ausus est.

questions.prompt: The birds within the cage sang about the hour of dawn.
questions.answer: Avēs intrā caveam circā hōram lūcis cantābant.

questions.prompt: Toward his friends the sick man showed gratitude, though oppressed by a grave illness.
questions.answer: Ergā amīcōs aeger grātiam praestitit, gravī morbō oppressus.
